docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $500.00 FILED BY SCYTKOWSKI FRED AS TO DEFENDANT BARBE MICHELLE IND DBA UNDER WATER PETS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-14-1992 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 06
